notes.title: DuneCrawl Demo out now!
notes.content:
DuneCrawl demo is now out! Check out animated demo launch trailer:

[previewyoutube=q8SNZHnhO4M;full][/previewyoutube]

Demo includes the intro level of the game, about 20-25 minutes in length, and includes online+local coop.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375100/DuneCrawl_Demo

Let us know any feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/T9mtMbGEjh]Discord[/url]!
Thanks,
- Lee
